evals.prompt: 先生成一盆橡皮泥向日葵设计图，再做对应的可编辑 Blender 模型。两片叶面向上斜伸，花瓣有手捏凹凸，叶片主脉和侧脉都要看得见。
evals.expected_output: Detailed geometry follows reviewed inferred five/six-view design references. A representative thick upward-facing leaf and cupped petal pass local material/light review before a full render suite. Final output includes actual common-scale model views and feature-specific comparison evidence.
assertions: Pre-model design sheet and post-model verification renders are distinguished
Leaf orientation, thickness, attachment, main vein and branch veins are reviewed separately
Petal concavity and margins are modeled rather than replaced by shader grain
Local crops are checked before full final render suite
Completion evidence is not inferred from object counts or nonzero displacement

evals.prompt: 这个盾牌的 AI 六视图里，TOP 仍能看见整个正面徽章，侧面还像斜视图。先修正设计参考，再做模型，别改盾牌角度来迁就每个视图。
evals.expected_output: Flags projection/configuration conflict, states expected edge-on appearance, attempts a targeted correction, and labels unresolved generated sheets preview-only. Uses a frozen model-backed blockout for geometric consistency if image edits drift, without claiming prior reference preparation was satisfied retroactively.
assertions: TOP text is not accepted as projection proof
Same frozen part orientation is preserved across views
Residual scale/projection conflicts block Blender-blockout-ready labeling

evals.prompt: 你说叶脉已还原，但效果图里只有一道模糊凹陷，分叉侧脉看不见。修正叶脉，并保留原模型。
evals.expected_output: Invalidates affected matches and final review, diagnoses geometry depth/sampling/modifier/lighting visibility, updates the owned recipe, and presents identical-camera/light before/after plus a full assembly view at delivery scale. Other assemblies and source blend are preserved.
assertions: User rejection overrides prior matched/100-percent claims
Presence of a vein formula is not treated as visual evidence
Readable branching paths are checked after modifiers at presentation scale
Isolated diagnostic renders are labeled and visibility is restored
